_comment: Optional per-image hints. roi=[x,y,w,h] overrides findROI. search_box=[x,y,w,h] restricts detectGeneric search. All 1-based pixel coords.

w1_sample_tiled.description: Inner photo region; exclude white drop-shadow frame ~23px each side

w3_proof_bold.description: Dark border ~8px; PROOF text band at bottom ~60px. ROI excludes border.

w5_zoner_single.description: Zoner Photo Studio X logo bottom-right; restrict search to bottom-right quadrant

wm1_india_currency.description: Currency note - no visible photo watermark overlay; Niteenk text bottom-right

wm2_kingfisher_idb.description: iDB logo bottom-right corner; small single instance

wm3_mountain_lake_alamy.description: Alamy watermark center-right; restrict to right half

wm4_road_ends_hd.description: HD badge top-right corner; small single instance

wm5_cliffs_jdoe.description: J. Doe Photography diagonal script center-left; circle logo top-right

wm6_city_hdrshooter.description: HDRSHOOTER diagonal text across center; treat as single large mark

wm7_luke_winter.description: LUKE COLLINS PHOTOGRAPHY tiled logos; same as w4_luke_logo

wm8_alpine_lake_zoner.description: Zoner Photo Studio X logo bottom-right; same watermark as w5_zoner_single
